retrieved_synopses: Karlach is in the party and meets the leader of the paladins of Tyr while she is nearby

The party encounters two novices of the Absolute , attending to a True Soul who had been leading them through the region. He now lies injured, but recognises us as having been tadpoled. He tells his novices that we are trustworthy, but they aren't so sure. We can convince them to do as we order, and tell them to leave the area or else set out to find the creature that attacked their True Soul leader.
Wary and abrupt. Disguised as a noble paladin of Tyr, this young is actually in league with the archdevil Zariel. She's hiding out in a tollhouse with her companions.

Following a trail of whispered ADs ('Psst. Over here!' 'Come on, before it's too late!') we find a pale elf, hunched down near some long grass. He insists an intellect devourer (brain monster with legs) is hiding there, trying to cajole you to look and kill it. If you approach the grass, a boar bursts out - it was a distraction while Astarion got behind you. He's on edge, but pleased to have the jump on you. He holds a blade to your throat while demanding you tell him what happened on the ship. After a mind meld (vision where he sees a glimpse of your past) you can convince him that you're both victims and should work together to find an answer. Once he realises you're not a threat his tone changes from threatening to charming.

These paladins signed their pact with Zariel for riches and power and serve her with relish. They've agreed to capture and kill Karlach, one of the origin characters.

This cultist is the leader of the group. He's friendly, but badly injured after his fight with Karlach.
context: You're with Karlach and encounter a wounded paladin leader (Anders) and his companions after a skirmish with her; Anders pleads for mercy and says they ambushed Karlach believing her a devil on orders from Tyr. Karlach is convinced these paladins are in league with the archdevil Zariel and is furious, her flames flaring as she refuses to let them go. The group's true allegiance is ambiguous in the scene: Anders insists they serve Tyr, but other context in the area suggests some paladins have secretly sided with Zariel and may be disguised. An insight/perception check can be offered but may not reveal a clear truth, leaving the player to decide whether to side with Karlach or the paladins.
